description: Safe Space - web application module submission

paragraphs: A MERN stack anonymous support platform built for a university project. SafeSpace gives people a judgment-free place to talk about personal struggles, connect with peers, and reach verified counselors — without giving up their anonymity.
For a complete reference — data models, auth model, full feature list, known limitations, and testing — see PROJECTDOCUMENTATION.md.
